notes.title: A new DLC is released
notes.content:
[h3]With this DLC you will be able to play on a big map with three cities on it. You will have to build transport infrastructure both in the cities and between them. The game area is surrounded by sea and mountains. The cities are separated by mountain ranges. You will be able to build railways through tunnels in the mountain ranges. The game area is two and a half times bigger than the biggest city in the game.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673540/d41ff65b09f10028847851828edeedc615b85665.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673540/ba7ae19a2ed4a8437dc394f519ffb9ed08bb9f64.png[/img]

[h3]Apart from the new content, a lot of work concerning optimization of the game resources has been done. Levels' loading speed was increased. Bugs found in editing trains were fixed. The process of positioning wagons in cases when trains are close to each other was improved.[/h3]

notes.title: The first DLC of the game is released
notes.content:
[h3]Every city will have four modes: Campaign, Evacuation, Survival and Relaxation.

If the expert difficulty is already available for you, you will be able to play it in the DLC. The expert difficulty mode in the DLC has Campaign and Evacuation modes.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673540/ac0315ae91e06bbe7c311a11b32d95077ee7a0fa.png[/img]

[u]Campaign.[/u] You need to transport a certain amount of passengers and cargo within the allotted time. During the game new stations will be opened and the number of passengers and cargo on stations will grow.

[u]Survival.[/u] Your task is to hold out as long as you can and see to it that stations are not overcrowded or overloaded. Build a good railway system and spend your money wisely.

[u]Evacuation.[/u] You need to evacuate all citizens to a particular station during a short period of time. It is not necessary to evacuate cargo, but it brings double income. Think how to manage the allocated time.

[u]Relaxation.[/u] In relaxation mode you don’t need to think about income or the accuracy of your routes. Develop your railway system as you wish and enjoy the game.


[h2]Сommercial centre[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673540/be3add5f2cf369c7b6e51028c7c02ab76b751c1a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673540/41d8a24cc44cf503f585fe7822a21b7066d5df35.png[/img]
The city is situated near the sea. Lots of industrial facilities, a seaport and stadiums make the city a major commercial and entertainment centre.
The city has 15 passenger stations and 7 cargo stations.


[h2]City by the sea[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673540/240b0ab90a21635f2604b509fa5dd7cb12aa2f5d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673540/00421930e52673beb27738616e568a1509c9de88.png[/img]
The city is surrounded by the sea on three sides and is situated on islands. It offers a lot of opportunities to create a railway system. Make the best routes to transport passengers and goods.
The city has 12 passenger stations and 7 cargo stations.

	
[h2]Between two shores[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673540/f127b4f3074daa89f962af4182fc2a68ecba00ed.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35673540/6cc358eb96400c571fd412f096953437798cba63.png[/img]
The city has a lot of canals and bridges. You will need to use all your knowledge about building railways. Create interesting routes between islands in order to make an efficient railway network.
The city has 14 passenger stations and 6 cargo stations.


[h3]Follow the link to take a look at the DLC:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1397250/My_Train_Arrives__City_pack/

[b]Write what you think about the DLC. I will be glad to read your comments.

I hope you will like the DLC![/b]

notes.title: Expert difficulty
notes.content:
[b]1. Added Campaign and Evacuation modes in Expert difficulty.[/b]

In order to get access to the Expert difficulty you need to successfully complete the Campaign mode in every city. After you win the last Campaign, a corresponding button will appear in the main menu. If you have previously completed the Campaign mode, you may play the Expert difficulty right away.

Playing the Expert difficulty you will have to use all your knowledge and skills.

[b]Key features:[/b]

- Adjusted balance. Most likely the usual strategies won’t be successful. In order to win you will have to make the best use of the railroad.
- In the Campaign mode you need to transport more passengers and goods within the same period of time as in the normal difficulty.
- In the Evacuation mode you need to evacuate much more passengers within the same period of time as in the normal difficulty.
- The saving function is disabled in this mode. That is why the cost of every mistake will be much higher.

[b]Other Upgrades:[/b]

2. The user’s interface became more convenient.

3. Problems with textures in low graphic settings were fixed.

[b]Write what you think about the new mode. I will be glad to know your opinion.[/b]

Thank you.

notes.title: New colors for the favourite game
notes.content:
1. Color schemes were added.
You can choose different color schemes in the settings menu.
The “warm” color scheme is set as default.
The scheme that was used as a default color scheme before the update is called "classic".
All in all, there are 6 color schemes available: classic, deep, light, dark, warm and paper.

2. The balance in the "Survival" mode was revised.
- The speed with which passengers and goods appear on stations was changed.
- The number of passengers and goods grows slower.
- The seed money is increased. 
I hope it will make the game more interesting and challenging.
